Dr Julian Medical Group Limited (“Dr Julian”, “we”, “us”, “our”) is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy.
This policy explains how we collect, use, store and share your personal data when you use our website, platform, and mobile applications.
If you have any questions, please contact:

Dr Julian Medical Group Limited is the data controller for the personal data collected through the platform, except where independent mental health professionals act as separate data controllers for clinical care.

To provide access to the platform and manage bookings.
To improve services, prevent fraud, and ensure platform security.
For marketing communications and certain optional data processing.
To comply with regulatory and legal requirements.
